Would you expect Algeria to have a metro like this? 🇩🇿🚇 I honestly didn’t know what to expect before riding the metro in Algiers, but it ended up being one of the biggest surprises of my time in Algeria. The Algiers metro is modern, clean, easy to use, and incredibly affordable. A single ride costs only around $0.20, making it one of the best ways to get around the city. This might be the best metro in all of Africa. 🇩🇿 #algeria #algiers #travelafrica #solotravel
